en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Once we all had climbed down the ladder, we
looked around and saw an open area.
It's more spacious than I thought it'd be...
Yodelay-hee-hoooooo!
What is this place...?

An old industrial passageway, I suspect...
Perhaps factories once existed here?
And this is all that's left of 'em.
Hey, take a look at this.

What a considerate sign... Apparently,
the end of the tunnel is the exit.

Considerate? You don't think it's weird that
someone went out of their way to write "<CLT=cltSTRONG>exit<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?

Hah-haha! Don't piss yourself in fear!
Your natural scent is bad enough!
I-I'm not scared! And I smell just fine!

Well then, go on ahead.
No point standing around here.
Ah, yeah...
No need to worry!

It looks a bit dangerous, but we're all
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> here!

As long as we work together, everything will
work out just fine!
Y-Yeah...you're right.

That's exactly what I was gonna say!
We're really on the same wavelength, Kaede!
Gimme a hug!
Um...no.

Typical degenerate behavior! You were trying to
trick her into pressing her boobs against you!
Uh... What...?

<CLT=cltMIND>As I slowly opened my eyes, it dawned on me
that I had somehow lost consciousness.
Oh!
You're awake... Are you alright?
I-I'm fine, but what about everyone else?

<CLT=cltMIND>I looked around and saw the others sitting
on the ground.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone sat in stunned silence...
A sobering sadness filled the air—

Geez, this is quite the pity party you sadsacks
are throwing for yourselves!
M-Monokuma!?

Wow, you all look exhausted.
Poor things. I feel sorry for you.

Sheesh, this place is filthy. It's murder on
my cashmere skin.

I bet Monodam is feelin' lucky right now!
His body's already a cheap piece of junk!

Why don'tcha respond to him, Monodam?
It'll liven things up a little, y'know?

Tch... So you guys crawled outta your holes.
I guess you finally noticed what we were up to.
...Noticed?

I've known for a while that you guys would
botch whatever escape plan you had.
What?

Y-Yeah, I also...kinda...pretty much knew,
too...
...That's a lie.
If you knew all along, then this was just a trap.
Then there *was* no exit! You tricked us!
...No, there's an exit.

I think you guys'll manage to reach it
if you all work together!

Yeah! There's nothing you 16 <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>
can't accomplish if you work together!
Puhuhu. And if at first you don't succeed...
...try, try again.

Try as many times as you want until you
accept reality! Ah-hahahaha!
Kyahahahaha!

Nyeeeh, so we can escape if we
work hard enough...?

No way, you little moron! They'd be freakin'
out if we could actually reach it!
That's probably why they let us try.

They wanted us to try the underground passage
so we'd learn that escape is impossible.

Instead of blocking off every exit completely,
they leave that little bit of hope...

They want us to be <CLT=cltSTRONG>desperate to go home<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Corner us mentally.
That's just rotten...
Yeah, but we can't just give up...

Right, you guys? I mean, we've only failed once,
y'know.
We can't give up this early, right?
But...isn't getting out of here impossible?

No, it's not. It may take one more try or a lot
more tries, but it's not impossible.

Forget about Monokuma. It doesn't matter what
he says to us.

I don't wanna lose to him! And I don't want any
of you to lose, either!

I refuse to lose to someone who would do
these terrible things to us!
Kaede...

So let's all work hard to escape this place
together!

And once we get out of here and make it
to the outside world...
Why don't we all stay friends?
...F-Friends?

Yeah... After going through an experience like
this, I think we'd all be the best of friends.

I mean, it's not every day you get to meet
other <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
...So what do you say?
Hmph...that might not be bad.
Yeah. That's a great idea.

Then we've all the more reason to escape
this place, no matter what.

My body is ready! You can tell by how outta
control my pit sweat is!
E-Everyone!

Isn't it premature to say what we'll do after
we escape? Assumptions are all but useless.

Geez, you're clueless... Why am I not surprised
that a robot can't read the air?

Robots can read the air! Thanks to innovations
in pollutant-detecting technology, I—

Anyway, it doesn't matter if Monokuma says it's
impossible! We'll show him what we can do!
Yeah! You're right!
It seems like a pain...but I guess I'll try.

Yeah, let's work together! We messed up last
time, but I'm sure it'll go well this time!

I'm sure we'll be fine. A divine wind will
blow through and lift us to victory.

Aaah, humanity is *truly* wonderful. The way
you all confront adversity is beautiful.

<CLT=cltMIND>With our bond stronger than ever, we stepped
into the tunnel once more.
Uh...uuhhh...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I finally woke up, searing pain coursed
throughout my entire body.
I-I see... I lost...consciousness again...

Wh-What the—? And I was lookin' forward
to a happy ending!
Not yet! We're just getting started!

O-Of course!
This will be...a piece of cake!

Gonta gonna escape. Become friends with
everyone. Gentlemen...never give up!

Th-This time...!
This time...we'll reach the exit!
<CLT=cltMIND>This time...

<CLT=cltMIND>Those words carried me as I stepped into
the tunnel once again.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...
<CLT=cltMIND>It was no good.

<CLT=cltMIND>Even so, we refused to surrender... We kept
telling ourselves that "this time" we'll escape.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...we failed each time...

<CLT=cltMIND>With every attempt, we repeated the words
"this time" over and over again...
<CLT=cltMIND>But in the end, we couldn't do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought we'd be able to escape as long
as we never gave up...
<CLT=cltMIND>But it made no difference in the end.
Failed...again.
Damn it...!
I can't...go on...
Wait, we can't give up. This time, we'll—
...Knock it off already.
Huh?

You're free to keep trying on your own, but
forcing us to join you is basically torture.
T-Torture?

You know what really hurts? Being denied the
right to give up in an impossible situation...

You won't let us give up and no matter what
we say, you have the moral high ground...
That...doesn't sound like torture to you?

When you say we can't give up, you're not
inspiring us—you're strong-arming us!
I-I didn't mean it like that...
Hey, degenerate! Quit being so selfish!

I-I'm not being selfish...
The others feel the same way, too...
What?
E-Everyone...?

My spirit...is nearly broken...
This hardship gnaws at me...

Given the circumstance...the most logical
course of action would be to give up...

Yeah...I feel like Hisashi Mitsui in the 
second half of a basketball game.
I knew this was impossible from the start.

Kh... This bullshit is a waste of my
precious time and energy.

I can't let you all rely on my magic...
Besides, I don't have enough MP left.

I'm just relieved that no one was seriously
injured. Praise be to Atua.
P-Please, wait! We...no can give up!

You guys! Are you really okay with
not getting out of this place!?

We shouldn't have to push ourselves...
Let's just find another way out, okay?
What!?

...You're talking about the
killing game, aren't you?
Oh, so you're gonna interpret it like that, huh?

Wh-What are you saying!?
There's no way we can do the killing game!

Nee-heehee... Calm down. Want some bubble
gum? You can blow pretty big bubbles with it.

Oh-hoho... Looks like this little degenerate
wants his head smashed into the ground.
S-Stop, guys, we shouldn't be fighting...
Geez...

We fell apart pretty quick for a group that
decided to be friends and work together.

I'm sorry...this is my fault.
I'm so sorry...
No, Kaede...

I-Idiot! What're *you* apologizing for!?
It's not your fault at all!
...Really? I think it is Kaede's fault.
H-Huh!? Why!?

This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles.

It is now 10 p.m. <CLT=cltSTRONG>Nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL> officially starts
now.

Whether you've been good or naughty, it's
time to go tinkle and go to beddy-bye!

The dining hall and gym are locked during
nighttime, so be careful.
Kyahahahaha! Sweet dreams!

Nighttime, huh?
Welp, no sense pushing our luck.

We should probably just
get a fresh start tomorrow.
Fresh start?

We've each been assigned a room in the
dormitory. Perhaps we should rest there?
Heeeee! We're gonna rest there!?

The rooms aren't that bad. Much better
than my prison cell, that's for sure.

But...it makes me nervous to think we'll be
staying the night at this creepy school.

Well, nothing we can do but suck it up!
So what's our plan for tomorrow?

Since the dining hall opens at 8 a.m.,
how about we meet there at that time?

Sure, I think that'll work.
I'm okay with that.
Can we go to our rooms already?

Yes, we should get as much rest as we can
and regain our strength.

Nyeeeh...I dunno if I can go pee by myself
in the middle of the night.

I'll come with you! If you don't mind, that is!
Just lemme know!
Hey, guys? Just...as a warning...

We shouldn't let our guards down.
We'll be easy targets at night.
C-Cuz of killing game, you mean?

I see no need to worry about something as
illogical as murder taking place here.
I know, I know. Just a warning.

Ah, if we all...work together...it'll be okay.
I'm sure of it.
Um, Kaede?

I don't think you need to worry
about what Kokichi said.

You weren't pressuring us.
At least, I don't think so.
Yeah... Thanks, Shuichi.

But I'm exhausted.
Let's just go back to our rooms and rest.

...Right.
Well...see you tomorrow.
What's up? You wanna give me that hug after all?
No, not really...

Hey, you don't gotta hold back!
We're two of a kind, y'know!?

Hey, you two, quit flirting.
Can't you read the air?
W-We're not flirting!
...You guys are annoying.

Hey, why did you apologize before?
You didn't do anything wrong, y'know?

Well...when we tried to escape, I felt like
we were united behind a common goal.

But after I put everyone's lives at risk, that
unity is gone now.

Shut up! That's just the stupid end result!
It's not like you wanted it to go that way!

Listen up. Don't apologize for something that's
not your fault! It'll just make you feel bad!

Everyone just decided to blame you and give up.
I'm gonna give 'em a piece of my mind later.

Well, anyway, let's just go to sleep for now.
See ya tomorrow.
<CLT=cltMIND>Thank you, Kaito.

Th-This isn't the time for talking!
Let's hurry and keep going!

Even if this is a trap...all we need to do
is fight and struggle our way out of it.

It'll be dangerous, of course...
But it's better than rotting away here.
Conversation with Ryoma Hoshi Nighttime after the escape game

Welp, we gotta keep trying.
Nothing's gonna change if we don't try.

Conversation with Rantaro, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime

So it was exit!
Gonta glad he tell everyone!
Come, everyone! Gonta protect you!

Conversation with Gonta, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime
Yodelay-hee-hoooooo!

Ooohh! It echoes well!
Must be pretty big then.

A giant underground passage is so exciting!
I wanna play hide-and-seek in here!
Hide-and-seek?

Nee-heehee... I am *the* master of
hide-and-seek.

As the supreme leader of an evil organization,
I'm always on the run from the law...

And over time, I just became a total pro
at hiding.
...Just kidding! That was a lie!
Yeah, I thought so...

I guess now's not a good time to play hide-
and-seek, though. Too bad...
When Kokichi yodelled earlier...

His echoes reminded me of tales told
in mountain villages.

They believe that voices echoing off the
mountains are replies from Yamabiko, the spirit—

...Ah, this may take too long. I shall save the
rest for after we have safely escaped.

I shall save the rest for after we have
safely escaped.
...It's quite dusty in here.

Prolonged exposure to this polluted air may
be detrimental to one's health.

Whaaat? Polluted air bothers you?
But you don't even breathe air, right?
W-Well, that is...

While it's true that I do not breathe, I also do
not like polluted air any more than you do.

I see, you have a function for sensing poisonous
gases! Well then, lead the way!

N-No! I don't have that function!
Do I look like a canary to you?

Whaaat, you don't? Then you're even more
useless than a canary!
Grgh...

While it's true that I do not breathe, I also do
not like polluted air any more than you do.

An underground passage that has not been in
use for some time...must be quite dangerous.

But if everyone wishes to proceed...then
I will do my best to support that decision.

Conversation with Kirumi, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime

It's dark here... If we're gonna keep going,
we need a light...

Then shouldn't you use magic to light it up?
You know...like "Lumos!" or something?
...We should be fine without a light.

Magic power is precious... I need to save it
for when we really need it.
U-Um, okay...

Magic power is precious... I need to save it
for when we really need it.

...If we're going, let's hurry up already. It'll
be a pain if Monokuma and his cubs appear.

Conversation with Maki, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime
Don't worry! If something happens...

...then I'll protect the girls by using all the
degenerate males as human shields!

Conversation with Tenko, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime

We're going to escape from the 
underground passage...

We should be careful of dangerous creatures.
Does everyone have their Protect Gear?
...Just kidding. It was just a joke.
Besides...something worse might show up...

Those Exisals are probably too big to get
into the underground passage, though...

You're so amazingly strong, Gonta!
I want a piggy-back ride!

Conversation with Angie, Post-Escape Game
Nighttime

You're too weak, Keebo! Lemme remodel you
and I'll make you the strongest robot ever!

First, I'll soup up your crotch plate by
installin' a nice, thick one, just how I like it!
Hah-hahaha!

Conversation with Miu Post-Escape Game
Nighttime

<CLT=cltMIND>What's the point of going back!?
We gotta move forward!

<CLT=cltMIND>What's the point of going back!?
We gotta move forward!
Yes
No

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
<CLT=cltMIND>It'll probably be okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>There'll be an exit at the end of this...
And once we reach it, this'll all be over...
<CLT=cltMIND>I just know it!

<CLT=cltMIND>I clung fiercely to that belief as we
stepped into the tunnel.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You're about to take on the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Death Road of Despair<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The objective is simple.
Everyone works together to escape!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press the <PAD=【Ｌ⇔】> and <PAD=【Ｐ⇔】> directional buttons to move,
and press the <PAD=【×】> button to jump.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You'll encounter plenty of <CLT=cltSTRONG>traps<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
set up to prevent you from escaping.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you hit a trap or fall
off a ledge...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>That person will be <CLT=cltSTRONG>eliminated<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, and control
will switch to one of the remaining students.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If everyone is eliminated...
Game over, man.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh, sorry. Didn't mean for things
to get that real.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>For now, stay vigilant and
<CLT=cltSTRONG>do your best to reach the exit<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...Not that it matters.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone left, so I should head back to
my room, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>The sign says "exit" and everything...
What a cruel joke...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone left, so I should head back to
my room, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>What's the point of going back!?
We gotta move forward!
Dammit... This is it for me...
Is everyone okay?
Where is the exit...?
Let's try it.
Everyone, be careful!
Hup!
DAMN IT!!!
Leave it to me!
Let's get pumped!
Let's do it!
Leave it to me!
Hup!
Still...got a ways to go...
Follow me.
Be careful.
It's not over yet!
I guess I'm up...
Hm!
Looks like it's no good...
I wonder where the exit is...
Are you okay?
You guys are incredible!
Let's go!
Hup!
Sorry...everyone...
Gentleman no lose!
Gonta handle this!
Everyone okay?
Gonta do his best!
Hup!
Ah-haha...I'm not gonna make it.
Let's have more fun!
Let's do this!
Are you guys still alive?
Let's have fun with this!
Alley-oop!
So this is the end...
How do you fare?
This may prove difficult...
Where, I wonder, is the exit?
I shall go...
Hah...
I miscalculated...
Let's find the exit!
Is everyone alright!?
We have to do this.
Leave it to me, everyone!
Hup!
I am a failure...as a maid...
I will do my best.
I will do it for everyone's sake.
Is everyone alright?
Let us proceed.
Ha!
I couldn't do it...
I'll do it...with magic!
Gotta do my best!
Where's the exit?
I guess I'll go...
Nyeh!
Tsk...
Let's get it over with...
Where's the exit?
This place is trouble.
Let's go.
Fu!
I'm sorry! I couldn't do it!
HAAAIYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!
Sneak attack!
I will protect you!
I'll do it!
Ha!
Nooooooooooooooo!
I'm gonna try my best!
Is everyone okay?
I wonder where the exit is.
Time to do my best!
Umph!
Nyahahaha! Bye-onara!
Gimme strength!
Ohhhh!
How divine!
Atua's on my side.
Hi-yup!
Ahhhhhh!
I fuckin' ruuuuule!
You shitheads still alive!?
Bring it on!
Fine. I'll fuckin' do it.
Yup!
I can't...lose here...
Good job, everyone!
Follow me!
I'll do my best!
I'll get us out of here!
Hup!
Dammit... This is it for me...

Where is the exit...?
Let's try it.
Everyone, be careful!
Hup!
